title: store.item@1
description: One item of a plug-in's store (#363): a kind the plug-in declares, ext.<plugin>.<name>, written only by that plug-in, at the store generation whose schema it holds to; the newest item for a key is the store's value, and the call the hub wrote it for, if any.

kind.description: The store kind, as the plug-in's manifest declares it.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: The plug-in that owns the store kind: only it writes its items.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

key.description: The item's key within its kind.

generation.description: The store generation whose schema the value holds to; a migration moves an item only to a higher one.

value.x-opaque: the item, held to the store's schema by the plug-in's host

call.description: The action call the hub wrote it for, or null for a migration.
